newsitem.title: USA: J.P. Morgan files $500 mln shelf offer.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan files $500 mln shelf offer.

text.p: Three business trusts formed by J.P. Morgan & Co Inc said Friday they filed a shelf registation with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $500 in preferred securities.
The three trusts, known as JPM Capital Trust II, JPM Capital Trust III and JPM Capital Trust IV, will use the proceeds to invest in junior subordinated debt securities of the parent.

J.P. Morgan intends to use the proceeds from the sale of the debt securities for general corporate purposes, including investment in equity and debt securities and interest-bearing deposits of the subsidiaries.
General corporate purposes may also include the repurchase of issued and outstanding preferred and/or common stock of J.P. Morgan, the filing said.
J.P. Morgan, based in New York, provides banking and other financial services to corporations, governments, institutions and individuals.
When combined with a previous registration, J.P. Morgan will have a total offering of $750 million in securities available for sale, the filing said.
